ROSHAN DASH Investment Banking Middle Office | FX & Equity Trade Support | Finance Professional roshandash.rd310@gmail.com | +91 8249727056 | +91 9178480022 | Mumbai, India | linkedin.com/in/roshan- dash-075a1b23a DOB: 03 Oct 2002 | Place of Birth: Sundargarh, Odisha, India | Nationality: Indian

PROFILE

Finance professional with three years of progressive experience spanning energy-sector financial analysis and investment banking middle-office operations for two of the global leading financial institutions. Currently embedded within eClerx's trade support team, providing front-to-back operational coverage for Morgan Stanley's New York FX desk and Goldman Sachs Equity Execution Services (EES). Track record of resolving high-value trade breaks, strengthening reconciliation controls, and partnering with senior front-office stakeholders across global time zones.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Financial Analyst

eClerx Services Ltd | Client: Morgan Stanley (FX Desk, New York) & Goldman Sachs (EES- Asia) Oct 2024 – Present | Mumbai, India

Equity Execution Services (EES) — Goldman Sachs Singapore

Manage trade booking, trade amendments, and pre-matching activities before settlement. • • Execute trade amendments through the Helix application upon identifying economic mismatches that result in incorrect trade bookings; proactive correction prevents trade failures and eliminates penalty exposure from missed settlement cut-offs, enabling direct trade settlement with counterparties.

Investigate unsettled trades and resolve booking, settlement, and counterparty discrepancies.

Leverage Traiana to monitor real-time trade booking status and take targeted corrective action — including direct counterparty escalation of erroneous bookings — to ensure timely and accurate settlement.

FX Trade Support — Morgan Stanley NY

Supported end-to-end trade lifecycle management for FX Spot, Forward, NDF, Options, Futures, and OTC derivative products.

Worked with the Fixed Income team at Morgan Stanley, supporting the Middle Office desk and handling various fixed-income securities, including bonds that required booking through FINRA. Coordinated closely with brokers to ensure accurate trade details, appropriate booking, and timely resolution of any discrepancies.

Performed trade reconciliation, break investigation, cash matching, and settlement exception management. • Worked on front-to-back issue resolution using Refinitiv and Bloomberg. • Prepared operational risk reports and escalated time-sensitive discrepancies to trading and operations teams.

Escalated over $8 billion in duplicate trade discrepancies and outstanding trades to the Front Office, mitigating operational risk exposure across FX Spot and FX Forward portfolios.

Achieved T+0 settlement on vanilla trades and implemented a structured escalation workflow that reduced the average age of outstanding breaks by 40%, resolving more than $5 billion in trade discrepancies.

Directed the comprehensive trade lifecycle for NDFs and non-NDF currencies, ensuring smooth derivatives settlements — recognised among the team's top 5% performers.

Reconciled complex broker and trader accounts while collaborating with global Front Desk teams to ensure timely trade execution; reduced errors by 12% and cut query resolution time by 15% by maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base for the NY client base.

Project Associate

Swain & Sons Power Tech Pvt. Ltd. Jun 2023 – Jun 2024 | Bhubaneswar, India

• Conducted financial data analysis, energy bill reviews, and profitability assessments for client projects. • Prepared management reports supporting pricing, cost evaluation, and project feasibility. • Coordinated with clients to resolve billing discrepancies and operational financial queries. • Supported business proposal preparation and commercial reporting.

EDUCATION

Bachelor's in Business Administration (Finance) Centurion University of Technology and Management, Bhubaneswar, India | 2020 – 2023 | CGPA: 7.75/10 (77.5%) Relevant Coursework: Banking · Security Analysis · Portfolio Management · Financial Management · Quantitative Techniques · Banking & ALM · Project Appraisal

12th Class (Higher Secondary) Overall: 79% | English: 81 | Business Studies: 79

TECHNICAL SKILLS & DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE

Products: FX Spot, FX Forward, FX Future, NDF, Equity Cash/Swaps, Equity Execution Services Operations: Trade Life Cycle · T+0/T+1 Settlement · Pre-matching · Break & Exception Management · Cash Reconciliation · KRI Reporting · Trade Escalation Management · Client Facing Operations Systems: Triana · Refinitiv · Bloomberg · Helix · Salesforce · MS Excel (Advanced) Languages: English (C1) · Hindi (Native) · Odia (Native)

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Awarded "Skill of the Year 2025 in Generative AI" certificate by the Technical University of Munich (TUM). • Holder of APS (Academic Preliminary Review) Certificate. • Professional experience with cross-border institutional workflows. • Exposure to multi-asset post-trade operations. • Certified in Lean Manufacturing Systems & Industry 4.0.
